modVersion.description: The four-part version of the mod that wrote the file; the other files match the catalog written by the same version.

exportedAt.description: When the file was last written, in ISO 8601 with the local time's UTC offset.

trigger.description: What caused the export that last wrote the file.

company.description: The company's day, funds, morale, reputation and techs.

financialReport.description: The next financial report, as the finance screen projects it.

workQueue.description: The timeline's entries, by the day they finish; entries finishing on the same day are in the order mech lab, med bay, travel, financial report, ship upgrade.

ship.description: The Argo; `null` when the company still flies the Leopard.

pilots.description: The pilots in the barracks, the commander first.

mechs.description: The mechs in the mech bay, readying ones included, by bay row and position.

mechsAwaitingPlacement.description: The new mechs the game asks to place, store or scrap, in order.

lastLance.description: The units of the lance last sent on a mission.

storage.description: What the company keeps in storage.

stores.description: The current star system's stores, each `null` when the star system has none or the company can't use it. Their stock is restocked on arrival in a star system; purchases take from it.

hiringHall.description: The pilots for hire in the current star system's hiring hall.

activeContract.description: The travel contract the company has accepted; `null` when there's none.

contracts.description: The contracts the Command Center offers, without the active contract, generated for the export when the game hasn't yet; during a trip, only from the jump into the destination on.

position.description: Where the ship is: the star system, and the travel under way.

events.description: The events scheduled, drawn lately or used up; their requirements check the tags and statistics on their scope's entry, e.g. company.

Company.description: The player's mercenary company: its funds, morale, standing and staff.

name.description: The company's name, as the player chose it.

dropship.description: The company's ship: the Leopard at the start, later the Argo.

daysPassed.description: The days passed since the career began; every day number in the export (e.g. `readyOnDay`) is on this scale.

morale.description: The company's morale, with its level in rules.json moraleLevels.

mercenaryReviewBoard.description: The company's standing with the Mercenary Review Board.

reputation.description: The reputation with each faction that gains it, keyed by faction id; the Mercenary Review Board's is mercenaryReviewBoard.

mechTech.description: The tech points the mech lab works a day (rules.json campaign.mechLab), including temporaryMechTechChanges.

temporaryMechTechChanges.description: The changes events made to mechTech for a time, by end day.

medTech.description: The med tech skill, which adds heal points for each injured pilot a day (rules.json campaign.medBay), including temporaryMedTechChanges.

temporaryMedTechChanges.description: The changes events made to medTech for a time, by end day.

maxPilots.description: The pilots the barracks hold, not counting the commander; no more can be hired.

tags.description: The company's tags, sorted, which the events' requirements check.

statistics.description: The company's statistics some event's requirements compare, keyed by the game's name, as they compare them; a statistic the company doesn't have is 0. The stored components' counts they compare are in Storage.components.

DropshipType.description: The company's ship: the Leopard, later the Argo.

Morale.description: The company's morale and the level it falls in.

value.description: The company's morale; level is the highest whose rules.json moraleLevels[].startsAt it reaches.

level.description: The name of the current level in rules.json moraleLevels.

MercenaryReviewBoard.description: The company's standing with the Mercenary Review Board, shown as its own bar in the UI.

value.description: The rating value; level is the highest whose rules.json mercenaryReviewBoardLevels[].startsAt it reaches.

level.description: The rating level, from 0, as in rules.json mercenaryReviewBoardLevels[].level.

FactionReputation.description: The company's reputation with a faction, and its alliance with it.

faction.description: The faction the reputation is with.

value.description: The reputation points with the faction; level is the highest whose rules.json reputationLevels[].startsAt they reach.

level.description: The reputation level, described in rules.json reputationLevels.

isAllied.description: Whether the company is allied with the faction.

isEnemy.description: Whether the faction is an enemy of a faction the company is allied with.

isDisplayed.description: Whether the game's reputation screen lists the faction; story events add and remove factions.

DefinitionReference.description: A game definition: its id from the game's data files and the name shown in the UI.

id.description: The definition's id from the game's data files, or its name in the game's enumeration where it has no data file (e.g. the player's faction).

SimGameReputation.description: A reputation level, described in rules.json reputationLevels.

TemporaryChange.description: A change an event made to a value for a number of days; the value includes it until it ends.

amount.description: What the change adds to the value; negative for a reduction.

endsOnDay.description: The last day the change applies, on the scale of Company.daysPassed; the game reverts it as the next day starts.

FinancialReport.description: The next financial report, as the finance screen projects it.

dueOnDay.description: The day the report is due, on the scale of Company.daysPassed.

spending.description: The spending level, and what the report would deduct at each level.

expectedExpenses.description: What the report deducts at the current spending level, line by line.

Spending.description: The company's spending level, which scales the expenses of each financial report and changes morale.

level.description: The spending level confirmed at the last report, applying until the next one.

options.description: Every spending level, with what the next report deducts at it.

EconomyScale.description: A spending level, from the cheapest to the most generous.

SpendingOption.description: A spending level the company can choose, with what the next financial report deducts at it.

level.description: The spending level, whose cost multiplier and morale change rules.json campaign.finances.spendingLevels[] has.

expectedExpenses.description: The C-Bills the next report deducts at this level, as ExpectedExpenses.total does at the current one.

ExpectedExpenses.description: What the next report deducts if nothing changes until then. The lines are rounded one by one like on the game's finance screen, so they can differ from total by a few C-Bills.

total.description: The C-Bills the report deducts at the current spending level.

ship.description: The ship's base upkeep, without its upgrades.

shipUpgrades.description: The upkeep of each ship upgrade that has any; empty before the company has the Argo.

mechs.description: The upkeep of each mech in the mech bay.

pilots.description: The salary of each pilot in the barracks but the commander, who draws none.

ShipExpense.description: The ship's line of the expenses.

name.description: The line's name on the finance screen: the Argo's operating costs, or the bank loan interest before the company has the Argo.

amount.description: The C-Bills the line deducts, rounded like on the game's finance screen.

ShipUpgradeExpense.description: A ship upgrade's line of the expenses.

upgrade.description: The ship upgrade whose upkeep the line is.

amount.description: The C-Bills the line deducts, rounded like on the game's finance screen.

MechExpense.description: A mech's line of the expenses.

mech.description: The mech in the mech bay whose upkeep the line is.

amount.description: The C-Bills the line deducts, rounded like on the game's finance screen.

MechReference.description: A mech in the mech bay, by its own id and name there (mechs).

id.description: The game's own id of the mech in the mech bay.

PilotExpense.description: A pilot's line of the expenses.

pilot.description: The pilot whose salary the line is.

amount.description: The C-Bills the line deducts, rounded like on the game's finance screen.

PilotReference.description: A pilot: their id, full name without callsign, and callsign.

name.description: The pilot's full name without callsign.

callsign.description: The pilot's callsign, which isn't part of name.

WorkQueueEntry.description: An entry of the timeline: a work order the company is waiting for. Each kind has a shape of its own, with the target it is about where it has one.

WorkQueueEntryKind.description: What a work queue entry is about, which decides the entry's other fields. `mechLab`: A mech lab order on a mech of the company. `medBay`: A pilot healing in the med bay. `travel`: The trip under way. `shipUpgrade`: A ship upgrade being installed. `financialReport`: The next financial report.

WorkOrderType.description: The game's kind of work order on the timeline.

FinancialReportOrder.description: The next financial report, of type `FinancialReport`.

kind.description: What the entry is about, which decides its other fields.

type.description: The game's kind of work order, e.g. `MedLabHeal` or `FinancialReport`.

finishesOnDay.description: The day it finishes, on the scale of Company.daysPassed.

MechLabOrder.description: A mech lab order, of the `MechLab…` types.

kind.description: What the entry is about, which decides its other fields.

type.description: The game's kind of work order, e.g. `MedLabHeal` or `FinancialReport`.

finishesOnDay.description: The day it finishes, on the scale of Company.daysPassed.

target.description: The mech the mech lab works on; `null` when the game can't resolve it.

MedBayOrder.description: A med bay order, of type `MedLabHeal`.

kind.description: What the entry is about, which decides its other fields.

type.description: The game's kind of work order, e.g. `MedLabHeal` or `FinancialReport`.

finishesOnDay.description: The day it finishes, on the scale of Company.daysPassed.

target.description: The pilot the med bay heals; always set, since the order holds the pilot itself.

ShipUpgradeOrder.description: A ship upgrade being installed, of the `ArgoUpgrade…` types.

kind.description: What the entry is about, which decides its other fields.

type.description: The game's kind of work order, e.g. `MedLabHeal` or `FinancialReport`.

finishesOnDay.description: The day it finishes, on the scale of Company.daysPassed.

target.description: The ship upgrade, as in Ship.upgrades; `null` when the game can't resolve it.

kind.description: What the entry is about, which decides its other fields.

type.description: The game's kind of work order, e.g. `MedLabHeal` or `FinancialReport`.

finishesOnDay.description: The day it finishes, on the scale of Company.daysPassed.

target.description: The star system the ship travels to; `null` when the game can't resolve it.

Ship.description: The Argo and its upgrades, as the engineering screen shows them.

upgrades.description: The upgrades the engineering screen shows: installed, installing or available ones, and the locked ones they lead to.

ShipUpgrade.description: A ship upgrade as the engineering screen shows it.

upgrade.description: The ship upgrade's id and name.

status.description: Where the upgrade stands, as the engineering screen shows it.

category.description: The engineering screen's group, e.g. `Mech Bay`.

location.description: The ship's room the upgrade is in, as its details name it, e.g. `MECH_BAY`.

details.description: The upgrade's description, which also names effects the stats don't, e.g. training.

requiredUpgrades.description: The upgrades that must be installed before this one can be bought.

price.description: The one-time C-Bills to buy the upgrade.

upkeep.description: The C-Bills the upgrade adds to the expenses of each report once installed; an installed upgrade's line in ExpectedExpenses.shipUpgrades is the same.

installDays.description: The days the upgrade takes to install.

effects.description: The changes the upgrade makes to company statistics once installed, as the engineering screen lists them.

ShipUpgradeStatus.description: Where a ship upgrade stands, as the Argo's engineering screen shows it. `installing`: Bought and being installed; it finishes as workQueue shows. `available`: Its required upgrades are all installed, so it can be bought, unless another upgrade is being installed or funds are short. `locked`: Not all of its required upgrades are installed yet, but each is installed, installing or available.

DropshipLocation.description: A room of the company's ship.

ShipUpgradeEffect.description: A change the upgrade makes to a company statistic once installed.

statistic.description: The game's name of the statistic, e.g. `MechTechSkill`.

value.description: The amount added to the statistic, or the value it is set to when isSet.

isSet.description: Whether the change sets the statistic to value instead of adding it.

description.description: The effect in the game's words, e.g. `+2 Morale`.

BarracksPilot.description: A pilot in the barracks: the commander or a roster member.

id.description: The game's pilot id, which the references to the pilot carry.

callsign.description: The callsign, which generated pilots can share.

type.description: The kind of pilot, which the barracks tells apart by color.

expertise.description: The barracks title derived from the primary abilities, e.g. `Recruit` or `Lancer`.

skills.description: The skill levels, whose effects rules.json skills lists per level.

abilities.description: The primary abilities only, described in rules.json skills; the passive traits follow from the skill levels.

health.description: The injuries at which the pilot is incapacitated.

tags.description: The pilot's tags, sorted, which the events' requirements check.

experience.description: The pilot's experience points, spent and unspent.

injuries.description: The injuries the pilot has, out of health; 0 when uninjured.

status.description: Whether the pilot is ready, injured or out of action because of an event.

readyOnDay.description: The day the pilot is ready again, on the scale of Company.daysPassed; `null` when `ready`.

spirits.description: The pilot's spirits, high, normal or low.

serviceRecord.description: The pilot's missions, kills and injuries so far, and the day of hire.

statistics.description: The pilot's statistics some event's requirements compare, keyed by the game's name, as they compare them; a statistic the pilot doesn't have is 0.

PilotType.description: The game's pilot types. `vanguard`: A Kickstarter backer's pilot.

Gender.description: A pilot's gender, which picks the wording of the texts about them.

Skills.description: A pilot's skill levels, each from 1 to 10.

gunnery.description: The Gunnery level, whose training table is rules.json skills.gunnery.

piloting.description: The Piloting level, whose training table is rules.json skills.piloting.

guts.description: The Guts level, whose training table is rules.json skills.guts.

tactics.description: The Tactics level, whose training table is rules.json skills.tactics.

unspent.description: The experience points available to spend on skills.

spent.description: The experience points already spent on skills.

PilotStatus.description: Whether a pilot can be deployed, as the barracks shows it. `unavailable`: Out of action without injuries, because of an event.

Spirits.description: A pilot's spirits, which events raise and lower for a while.

level.description: The spirits level, whose effects are in rules.json spiritsLevels.

endsOnDay.description: The day high or low spirits end, on the scale of Company.daysPassed; `null` when spirits are normal or the game sets no end.

SpiritsLevel.description: A pilot's spirits: normal, or temporarily high or low from an event.

ServiceRecord.description: A pilot's career in the company, as the barracks shows it.

missions.description: The missions the pilot has fought.

mechKills.description: The mechs the pilot has destroyed.

otherKills.description: The other units the pilot has destroyed: vehicles and turrets.

ejections.description: The missions the pilot ejected in.

lifetimeInjuries.description: The injuries the pilot has taken in missions, healed ones included.

hiredOnDay.description: The day the pilot was hired, on the scale of Company.daysPassed.

Mech.description: A mech in the mech bay, with its current loadout; each value of status has a shape with fields of its own.

MechStatus.description: Whether a mech in the mech bay is free for use or held by the mech lab. `readying`: Being readied from a stored chassis. `inMaintenance`: Being repaired or refitted.

MechLoadout.description: A mech's loadout with the tonnage, value and stats that follow from it; the chassis' limits are in catalog.json chassisDefinitions.

usedTonnage.description: The tonnage of the chassis, armor and components.

value.description: The C-Bill value the game computes from the chassis, armor and components.

stats.description: The mech lab's stat bars and the numbers behind them, for this loadout.

locations.description: The body locations with their armor, structure and components, from head to legs.

MechStats.description: The performance summary of the mech lab and mech bay: the ratings of the stat bars and the numbers behind them. Only working components count.

ratings.description: The ratings of the stat bars.

movement.description: The walk, sprint and jump distances.

heat.description: The heat dissipated, generated and tolerated.

firepower.description: The damage of firing every weapon at once.

range.description: The weapons' maximum and average medium range.

durability.description: The armor and structure, and the damage taken from the mech's own jump attack.

melee.description: The damage of melee and jump attacks.

StatRatings.description: The stat bars, each rated from 0 against the game's stock mechs; a bar is full at 10, which a rating can exceed.

firepower.description: Rated from the weapons' damage and stability damage.

movement.description: Rated from the sprint distance and the number of jump jets.

range.description: Rated from the weapons' average medium range.

heatEfficiency.description: Rated from the heat dissipation against the heat of firing every weapon and jumping, and from bonuses to the shutdown heat.

durability.description: Rated from the armor, the structure and upgrades reducing stability damage taken.

melee.description: Rated from the melee attack's damage and stability damage.

walk.description: The chassis' walk distance, as in catalog.json chassisDefinitions.*.movement.walk.

sprint.description: The chassis' sprint distance, as in catalog.json chassisDefinitions.*.movement.sprint.

jump.description: The jump distance with the working jump jets and their bonuses; 0 without any.

HeatStats.description: The heat dissipated, generated and tolerated.

dissipation.description: The heat removed per round by the built-in and mounted heat sinks.

alphaStrike.description: The heat generated by firing every weapon at once.

averageJump.description: The heat generated by an average jump.

shutdown.description: The heat at which the mech shuts down.

FirepowerStats.description: The damage of firing every weapon at once.

damage.description: The damage of all the weapons' shots; COIL weapons count with three evasion pips, as the game's stats assume.

stabilityDamage.description: The stability damage of all the weapons' shots.

max.description: The longest maximum range of the weapons, in meters.

optimal.description: The weapons' average medium range, in meters.

DurabilityStats.description: The armor and structure, and the damage taken from the mech's own jump attack.

armor.description: The armor left on all locations.

structure.description: The structure left on all locations.

deathFromAboveSelfDamage.description: The damage the mech takes from its own jump attack.

MeleeStats.description: The damage of melee and jump attacks.

damage.description: The damage of a melee attack, the chassis' plus upgrades' bonuses.

stabilityDamage.description: The stability damage of a melee attack, the chassis' plus upgrades' bonuses.

deathFromAboveDamage.description: The damage of a jump attack onto a target.

MechLocation.description: A body location of a mech in the mech bay, with its components.

armor.description: The armor left and fitted, by side.

structure.description: The structure left: below the chassis' when damaged, zero when destroyed.

components.description: The components mounted in the location, including the chassis' fixed ones.

front.description: The front armor; outside the torso, the location's only armor.

rear.description: The rear armor; `null` when the location is outside the torso.

Armor.description: The armor of one side of a location.

current.description: What is left after combat damage; refilled to assigned after a mission unless the location was destroyed.

assigned.description: The armor fitted in the mech lab.

MountedComponent.description: A component mounted on a mech in the mech bay.

component.description: The component, by the id its definition is keyed by.

damageLevel.description: The component's damage level, e.g. `Penalized` or `Destroyed`.

isFixed.description: Whether the component is part of the chassis: every mech of the chassis has it, and it can't be removed.

ComponentReference.description: A reference to a component's definition, with its type. Components are ordered by type, then by name, with the id breaking ties.

id.description: The component definition's id from the game's data files.

type.description: The game's component type, e.g. `Weapon` or `AmmunitionBox`, which names the component's group in catalog.json componentDefinitions; never `NotSet`, `Special` or `MechPart`, which the game's enum also has.

ComponentType.description: The game's kind of component, which names the component's group in catalog.json componentDefinitions.

MechInMaintenance.description: A mech being repaired or refitted; the changes still queued are in refit.

readyOnDay.description: The day the mech lab finishes the work order, on the scale of Company.daysPassed, as in workQueue.

id.description: The mech's own id, unique among the company's mechs.

name.description: The mech's name, which the player can change in the mech lab.

chassis.description: The mech's chassis, described in catalog.json chassisDefinitions.

bay.description: The mech bay row, counted from 1, as the mech bay shows it.

position.description: The position in the bay row, counted from 1.

status.description: Whether the mech is free for use or held by the mech lab, which decides the mech's other fields.

isFieldable.description: Whether the mech can be taken on a mission, as the lance configuration decides.

problems.description: The loadout problems the mech lab warns about, e.g. missing ammunition, in the game's words.

loadout.description: The current loadout, as the mech bay shows it.

refit.description: The steps of the mech's work order, in order; finished steps are already part of the loadout.

afterRefit.description: The loadout once every step of refit is finished, as the mech lab shows it.

RefitChange.description: One step of a mech's queued refit; each value of type has a shape with fields of its own.

RefitChangeType.description: The kind of a refit step. `installComponent`: Mounts a component taken from storage or removed from another location. `removeComponent`: Takes a component off the mech, into storage or for installation elsewhere.

InstallComponentChange.description: A step that installs a component.

component.description: The component the step installs, removes or repairs.

damageLevel.description: The component's damage level when the step was ordered.

type.description: The kind of step, which decides the step's other fields.

isDone.description: Whether the mech techs have finished the step; its change is then part of the mech.

ModifyArmorChange.description: A step that adds or removes a location's armor.

location.description: The mech location whose armor or structure the step changes.

type.description: The kind of step, which decides the step's other fields.

isDone.description: Whether the mech techs have finished the step; its change is then part of the mech.

armor.description: The location's armor after the change, by side.

front.description: The front armor; outside the torso, the location's only armor.

rear.description: The rear armor; `null` when the location is outside the torso.

RemoveComponentChange.description: A step that removes a component.

component.description: The component the step installs, removes or repairs.

damageLevel.description: The component's damage level when the step was ordered.

type.description: The kind of step, which decides the step's other fields.

isDone.description: Whether the mech techs have finished the step; its change is then part of the mech.

RepairComponentChange.description: A step that repairs a component.

component.description: The component the step installs, removes or repairs.

damageLevel.description: The component's damage level when the step was ordered.

type.description: The kind of step, which decides the step's other fields.

isDone.description: Whether the mech techs have finished the step; its change is then part of the mech.

location.description: Where the component is mounted; `null` when it's in storage.

RepairStructureChange.description: A step that repairs a location's structure.

location.description: The mech location whose armor or structure the step changes.

type.description: The kind of step, which decides the step's other fields.

isDone.description: Whether the mech techs have finished the step; its change is then part of the mech.

id.description: The mech's own id, unique among the company's mechs.

name.description: The mech's name, which the player can change in the mech lab.

chassis.description: The mech's chassis, described in catalog.json chassisDefinitions.

bay.description: The mech bay row, counted from 1, as the mech bay shows it.

position.description: The position in the bay row, counted from 1.

status.description: Whether the mech is free for use or held by the mech lab, which decides the mech's other fields.

isFieldable.description: Whether the mech can be taken on a mission, as the lance configuration decides.

problems.description: The loadout problems the mech lab warns about, e.g. missing ammunition, in the game's words.

loadout.description: The current loadout, as the mech bay shows it.

repair.description: What repairing the mech's damage in the mech bay would take; `null` when the mech is undamaged.

RepairEstimate.description: What the mech bay's Repair would take if ordered now, as its confirmation shows it.

days.description: The days the mech lab needs for the repair alone; it works on one order at a time, so an order queued behind others finishes later.

ReadyingMech.description: A mech being readied from a stored chassis.

readyOnDay.description: The day the mech lab finishes the work order, on the scale of Company.daysPassed, as in workQueue.

id.description: The mech's own id, unique among the company's mechs.

name.description: The mech's name, which the player can change in the mech lab.

chassis.description: The mech's chassis, described in catalog.json chassisDefinitions.

bay.description: The mech bay row, counted from 1, as the mech bay shows it.

position.description: The position in the bay row, counted from 1.

status.description: Whether the mech is free for use or held by the mech lab, which decides the mech's other fields.

isFieldable.description: Whether the mech can be taken on a mission, as the lance configuration decides.

problems.description: The loadout problems the mech lab warns about, e.g. missing ammunition, in the game's words.

loadout.description: The current loadout, as the mech bay shows it.

MechAwaitingPlacement.description: A new mech the game asks the player to place, store or scrap because every mech bay is full; it is in neither the mech bay nor storage until then.

chassis.description: The mech's chassis, described in catalog.json chassisDefinitions.

loadout.description: The loadout it comes with: the stock one for a mech assembled from parts or bought, none but the fixed components for a salvaged chassis.

LastLanceUnit.description: A mech and its pilot from the lance last sent on a mission. The lance configuration fills the contract's open slots with these, except the mechs and pilots that can't deploy.

mech.description: The mech; `null` when it has left the mech bay since, e.g. sold.

pilot.description: The pilot; `null` when they have left the company since, e.g. dismissed or killed.

Storage.description: What the company keeps in storage, outside its mechs.

component.description: The component, by the id its definition is keyed by.

count.description: The working copies; the damaged ones are in damagedCount.

damagedCount.description: The damaged copies, which need a repair, in storage or once mounted.

StoredChassis.description: A stored chassis. Readying it gives a mech with the stock armor and the chassis' fixed components, but no weapons or other components.

chassis.description: The chassis, described in catalog.json chassisDefinitions.

StoredMechParts.description: Stored parts of a mech, from which the mech is assembled.

mech.description: The mech the parts assemble into, described in catalog.json mechDefinitions.

StarSystemStores.description: The current star system's stores the company can use.

system.description: The system store; `null` when the star system has none or the reputation with its owner is `LOATHED`.

faction.description: The faction store; `null` when the star system has none or the company isn't allied with its owner.

blackMarket.description: The black market; `null` when the star system has none or the company hasn't gained access to black markets.

faction.description: The faction whose reputation sets the prices, by the price change in rules.json reputationLevels: the star system's owner for the system store, the store's own faction for the faction store, the pirates for the black market.

component.description: The component, by the id its definition is keyed by.

count.description: The copies in stock; `null` when unlimited.

price.description: The C-Bills for one copy, after the star system's discount and the reputation's price change.

MechForSale.description: A whole mech in stock. Buying it puts the mech with its stock loadout into the mech bay.

mech.description: The mech, described in catalog.json mechDefinitions.

count.description: The copies in stock; `null` when unlimited.

price.description: The C-Bills for one copy, after the star system's discount and the reputation's price change.

mech.description: The mech the parts assemble into, described in catalog.json mechDefinitions.

count.description: The copies in stock; `null` when unlimited.

price.description: The C-Bills for one copy, after the star system's discount and the reputation's price change.

HiringHallPilot.description: A pilot for hire in the current star system's hiring hall.

id.description: The game's pilot id, which the references to the pilot carry.

callsign.description: The callsign, which generated pilots can share.

type.description: The kind of pilot, which the barracks tells apart by color.

expertise.description: The barracks title derived from the primary abilities, e.g. `Recruit` or `Lancer`.

skills.description: The skill levels, whose effects rules.json skills lists per level.

abilities.description: The primary abilities only, described in rules.json skills; the passive traits follow from the skill levels.

health.description: The injuries at which the pilot is incapacitated.

tags.description: The pilot's tags, sorted, which the events' requirements check.

price.description: The one-time C-Bills to hire the pilot.

salary.description: The C-Bills the pilot would add to the expenses of each report once hired.

canHire.description: Whether the company's Mercenary Review Board rating and morale allow hiring the pilot; full barracks (Company.maxPilots), travel and funds can block it as well.

ActiveContract.description: The accepted travel contract, until the company proceeds with it on arrival or breaks it.

description.description: The contract's description, as the contract details show it.

lanceLimits.description: The limits on the lance the company can deploy on the mission.

biome.description: The biome of the map the mission is fought on, as the contract details show it; `null` when they show none.

id.description: The contract's id from the game's data files; `null` when the game keeps no reference to it.

name.description: The contract's name, as the contract list shows it.

type.description: The mission type, described in rules.json contractTypes.

displayStyle.description: Whether it's a regular, story, restoration or flashpoint contract.

employer.description: The faction that hires the company.

target.description: The faction the mission is fought against; `INVALID_UNSET`, which has no catalog.json factionDefinitions entry, for a story contract that only travels.

difficulty.description: The difficulty on the skulls' scale of 1 to 10 (two per skull), capped at rules.json campaign.contracts.maxGlobalDifficulty and limited by rules.json reputationLevels[].maxContractDifficulty.

terms.description: The terms the contract was accepted with.

arrivesOnDay.description: The day of arrival in the star system, on the scale of Company.daysPassed, as in Travel.arrivesOnDay; `null` when the ship isn't travelling there.

starSystem.description: The star system the mission is fought in, in full, as in star-systems.json starSystems, with the trip there.

maxMechs.description: The most mechs the lance can deploy.

minTonnage.description: The least total tonnage of the lance's mechs; `null` when there's no limit.

maxTonnage.description: The most total tonnage of the lance's mechs; `null` when there's no limit.

mechs.description: The tonnage limits of each mech slot, one per mech allowed; `null` when no slot has any.

MechSlotLimits.description: The tonnage limits of one mech slot of the lance.

minTonnage.description: The least tonnage of the mech in the slot; `null` when there's no limit.

maxTonnage.description: The most tonnage of the mech in the slot; `null` when there's no limit.

ContractDisplayStyle.description: Whether a contract is a regular, story, restoration or flashpoint contract.

AcceptedTerms.description: The terms a contract was accepted with.

shares.description: The slider positions the terms were negotiated at; `null` when the terms are fixed.

reputation.description: The reputation changes when the contract succeeds.

NegotiatedShares.description: The slider positions a contract's terms were negotiated at.

payPercent.description: The pay slider's position, from 0 to 100.

salvagePercent.description: The salvage slider's position, from 0 to 100.

Salvage.description: The salvage of a contract, in items.

total.description: The salvage items the company gets, including the priority salvage.

priority.description: The salvage items the company picks itself; the rest are assigned to it.

ReputationChange.description: The reputation changes of a contract: of its success, as the negotiation shows them, or of a mission's outcome.

employer.description: The change of the reputation value with the employer, usually a gain; `null` when the employer doesn't gain reputation.

target.description: The change of the reputation value with the target, usually a loss; `null` when the target doesn't gain reputation.

StarSystem.description: A star system with its active definition and its career state. The story swaps some star systems' definitions (e.g. to change their owner); the id and what the definition holds are the active one's.

id.description: The active definition's id, as in the references to the star system.

name.description: The name, as in the references to the star system.

owner.description: The faction that owns the star system.

tags.description: The star system's tags, sorted, which the events' requirements check, also those its starmap panel doesn't show.

biomes.description: The biomes the star system's missions can be on, sorted by name.

maps.description: The maps the star system's contracts can be fought on, as the contract generator selects them from its biomes and map tags; each map's terrain is in catalog.json mapDefinitions.

stores.description: The item collections each of the star system's stores draws its stock from on arrival, every entry of each once, by their ids in catalog.json itemCollectionDefinitions, sorted. A store without any doesn't exist in the star system.

contractEmployers.description: The factions that can hire the company for the star system's generated contracts, without the employers the story sets aside, sorted by name, each with its targets; a contract's own requirements can narrow them, and story and flashpoint contracts name their own.

difficulty.description: The star system's difficulty, as the starmap shows it.

canTravelTo.description: Whether the star system's travel requirements are met; story star systems stay locked until then.

route.description: The trip from the current star system; `null` when the game finds no route, always when canTravelTo is false.

ByStoreOfStringList.description: A value per store of a star system: its system store, faction store and black market.

system.description: The value for the system store.

faction.description: The value for the faction store.

blackMarket.description: The value for the black market.

ContractEmployer.description: A faction that offers contracts in a star system, with the factions they can be against.

employer.description: The faction that offers the contracts.

targets.description: The factions it can hire the company against there, sorted by name: its enemies among the star system's targets, except the company's allies and the targets the story sets aside.

Route.description: The trip from the current star system, as the starmap plans and shows it.

days.description: The days the trip takes from the current star system's planet, with the whole leg to its jump point (Travel.jumpPointDays) even during a trip, which Travel.legEndsOnDay corrects; 0 for the current star system.

cost.description: The C-Bills the trip costs; 0 for the current star system.

OfferedContract.description: A contract the Command Center offers, as its contract list and details show it.

description.description: The contract's description, as the contract details show it.

lanceLimits.description: The limits on the lance the company can deploy on the mission.

biome.description: The biome of the map the mission is fought on, as the contract details show it; `null` when they show none.

id.description: The contract's id from the game's data files; `null` when the game keeps no reference to it.

name.description: The contract's name, as the contract list shows it.

type.description: The mission type, described in rules.json contractTypes.

displayStyle.description: Whether it's a regular, story, restoration or flashpoint contract.

employer.description: The faction that hires the company.

target.description: The faction the mission is fought against; `INVALID_UNSET`, which has no catalog.json factionDefinitions entry, for a story contract that only travels.

difficulty.description: The difficulty on the skulls' scale of 1 to 10 (two per skull), capped at rules.json campaign.contracts.maxGlobalDifficulty and limited by rules.json reputationLevels[].maxContractDifficulty.

meetsReputation.description: Whether the reputation with the employer allows taking the contract; the list greys it out otherwise. Story, restoration and flashpoint contracts, and employers that don't gain reputation, are always allowed.

negotiation.description: The terms the contract can be accepted with: negotiated or fixed.

starSystem.description: The star system the mission is fought in, in full, as in star-systems.json starSystems, with the trip there: the current one, whose route takes 0 days and costs 0 C-Bills, or another the company travels to first.

Negotiation.description: The terms a contract can be accepted with; each value of canNegotiate has a shape with fields of its own.

FixedTerms.description: The terms of a contract that can't be negotiated.

canNegotiate.description: Whether the terms are negotiated with the sliders (NegotiableTerms) or fixed (FixedTerms).

reputation.description: The reputation changes when the contract succeeds.

NegotiableTerms.description: The terms of a contract negotiated with the sliders.

canNegotiate.description: Whether the terms are negotiated with the sliders (NegotiableTerms) or fixed (FixedTerms).

valuesByShare.description: The values at each slider position. A row is not a deal: the pay comes from the row at the pay share, the salvage from the row at the salvage share and the reputation from the row at the share left over.

ValuesAtShare.description: What one slider position gives, each value for its own slider.

pay.description: The pay in C-Bills when the pay slider is at this share.

salvage.description: The salvage when the salvage slider is at this share.

reputation.description: The reputation changes when this share is left over for reputation.

Position.description: Where the company's ship is, and where it's headed.

starSystem.description: The star system the ship is in, in full, as in star-systems.json starSystems; while travelling, the one it left or, once it has jumped, the last it jumped to.

travelStatus.description: Where the ship is on its way, e.g. `IN_SYSTEM` or `TRANSIT_TO_JUMP`.

travel.description: Where the ship is headed; `null` when it's in a star system.

SimGameTravelStatus.description: Where the ship is on a trip, or in a star system.

Travel.description: The trip the ship is on.

destination.description: The star system the ship travels to, at the end of its route, in full, as in star-systems.json starSystems.

arrivesOnDay.description: The day the ship arrives, on the scale of Company.daysPassed.

jumpPointDays.description: The days between the current star system's planet and its jump point, which every Route.days from the current star system includes in full.

legEndsOnDay.description: The day the leg under way ends, on the scale of Company.daysPassed: by Position.travelStatus, the jump point is reached, a jump is done or, after the last jump, the planet is reached.

EventState.description: The career's state of the events: those scheduled, drawn lately and used up.

recentlyDrawnEvents.description: The events the daily roll drew lately; it draws none of them again until no other event can come.

usedOneTimeEvents.description: The one-time events the daily roll has drawn, which it never draws again.

scheduledEvents.description: The events results have scheduled, in the order the game rolls them.

ScheduledEvent.description: An event a result has scheduled. Its days assume a daily roll every day from the next; the game skips it on arrival in a star system, when the story moves on, and for the events after one that comes that day.

pilot.description: The pilot the event is about; `null` when the game picks one when it comes.

earliestOnDay.description: The first day the event can come, on the scale of Company.daysPassed.

latestOnDay.description: The day the event comes for sure, on the scale of Company.daysPassed.

chancePercent.description: The chance per daily roll from earliestOnDay on, from 0 to 100.
